questions.answer: The handbook does not specify bereavement leave entitlements. The Leave Policy v2 only covers annual leave (16 days per year) and sick leave (8 days per year), and no other provided document mentions bereavement leave. [1] [2] [3] [4] [5] [6]

cited.quote: This policy sets out paid time off entitlements for full-time employees of Northgate Robotics in the United States. It was revised after the 2025 engagement survey to bring annual leave in line with the industry median
Full-time employees accrue 16 days of annual leave per calendar year, credited each pay period in equal parts
Employees receive 8 days of sick leave per year
Birth parents receive 16 weeks of fully paid leave, which runs concurrently with any FMLA entitlement
Employment is at will. When resigning, employees are asked to give 4 weeks' notice so that work can be handed over; during the introductory period one week is sufficient
Raise a grievance in writing to People Operations. You will receive an acknowledgement within two working days and a meeting within ten working days

questions.answer: Report the stolen laptop to IT and the Security team within 24 hours so it can be wiped remotely, and file a police report (a copy is needed for the insurance claim). Also report the incident immediately to security@northgate.example and post in #security-incidents.

cited.quote: Report a lost or stolen laptop to IT and the Security team within 24 hours so that it can be wiped remotely. File a police report for theft; a copy is needed for the insurance claim

If you suspect a security incident, such as a phishing email you clicked, a lost device, or unexpected access to a system, report it immediately to security@northgate.example and post in #security-incidents

questions.answer: Your team's engineering manager approves laptop replacements. You request the replacement through the IT portal, and the engineering manager provides the approval; IT fulfills the request once approved. [1][2] The policy states that approval comes from the employee's team engineering manager and IT does not approve replacements itself.

cited.quote: Approval for a replacement comes from the employee's team engineering manager; IT does not approve replacements itself
Who do I ask for a new laptop? Raise a request in the IT portal; your team's engineering manager approves it

questions.answer: No. RTO stands for Recovery Time Objective, which is the maximum acceptable time to restore a service after a disaster. It is not related to return-to-office arrangements; those are covered by the Remote Work Policy. [1] [2]

cited.quote: RTO: Recovery Time Objective. The maximum acceptable time to restore a service after a disaster. Not to be confused with return-to-office arrangements, which are covered by the Remote Work Policy
Employees past the introductory period may work remotely up to 2 days per week by default

questions.answer: If the primary on-call does not acknowledge a page within 15 minutes, the paging tool automatically pages the secondary on‑call. If the secondary also fails to acknowledge within another 15 minutes, the page escalates to the team’s engineering manager. During an active SEV1, responders should not wait for the timers and can call the secondary directly via the incident phone bridge on extension 304, which rings both the secondary and the manager simultaneously.

cited.quote: If the primary on-call does not acknowledge a page within 15 minutes, the paging tool pages the secondary automatically. If the secondary also fails to acknowledge within another 15 minutes, the page goes to the team's engineering manager

An engineer who needs help on an active SEV1 should not wait for the timers: call the secondary directly through the incident phone bridge on extension 304, which rings the secondary's phone and the manager's phone at the same time
